# plan-w3-r32 (W3-16K): S0 vs S7 (unchanged cells), n=1, at 32 req/s.
# n=1 per cell and rate; a different workload from W2, never pooled with it. Runs carry run_id q38-w3-* and label=w3-16k.
# Driver q38-matrix-driver/4; the plan grammar is in tools/matrix_driver/README.md.
# Trace: workloads/w3-16k (regen.sh 32 <dir>, then upload-inputs.sh), generated by demo-bench trace w2 with the
# W3-16K flags of workloads/w3-16k/params.json: 11 turns, ISL 5632 + 1024 k (global prefix 2048), cold 3 %
# at 15,872, OSL 500 (ignore_eos), mean inter-turn gap 75 s, N_s = 75 x rate, entries staggered over [0, 180 s),
# cut at 615 s; measured window for reporting [255, 615) s. Max ISL + OSL 16,372.
# SLO (absolute, fixed before any W3-16K data; an explicit plan SLO, no calibrate-slo, no SLO lock):
#   continuation TTFT <= 1.0 s; cold TTFT <= cold_factor x ISL / cold_prefill_tok_s = 1 x 15872 / 7936 = 2.0 s
#   (every cold row is 15,872 tokens); per-request mean ITL <= 25 ms. Entry rows are never judged by the SLO goodput.
# on_failure continue: a failed or invalid run (e.g. saturation errors) is recorded and the plan goes on.
# hard_stop is the instant of the recorded session: launch with render_driver.py --hard-stop-in.
# drain_s = the drain beyond the trace span (upper estimate) + 1800 s, a guard value only.
run_id q38-w3-r32
hard_stop 2026-10-24T09:00:00Z
on_failure continue
w2 trace=s3://${RESULTS_BUCKET}/matrix/inputs/w3-16k-r32-cb872dc5/w3-16k-r32.jsonl trace_sha256=cb872dc5c0aa9553d85b0f839387f56a6195f726ce4c9c29479e2b9cd4590301 sidecar=s3://${RESULTS_BUCKET}/matrix/inputs/w3-16k-r32-cb872dc5/w3-16k-r32.side.jsonl sidecar_sha256=fa68d96658c45eeead8446479154d8189eb5327a1a46afc67b5bfd16a16a4279 frozen=yes
tokenizer prefix=s3://${RESULTS_BUCKET}/matrix/inputs/tokenizer-qwen38-27b-fp8-017b9c7a/ sums_sha256=7c8e0b6c2c49bf09b305f0a2902aa2250c11302ea1a859ea7bca3f4d9f8c79be

run S0 1 label=w3-16k
